summary: iter149 — Smart Inbox competition-day extraction and competition detail/edit fields. BACKEND: 5/5 pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_iter149_inbox_competition.py. (5) Admin reseed endpoint cleans up to pristine state (status=done) and restored the applereview account. Full UI flow NOT fully retested in this run because the Playwright sign-in attempt hit a timing issue — subsequent protected calls returned 401 so the inbox/review modal/Summit detail page couldn't be exercised in the browser. All testIDs the request references (inbox-comp-new, comp-day-details, comp-meet-time-input, comp-meeting-location-input, comp-what-to-wear-input, comp-spectator-fee-input, comp-parking-fee-input, comp-day-details-input, inbox-confirm) are present in /app/frontend/app/inbox.tsx and /app/frontend/app/competitions/[id].tsx / new.tsx (code-reviewed).
